funding.name: MASSGrant
funding.provider: Massachusetts Department of Higher Education, Office of Student Financial Assistance
funding.provides: Need-based state grant funded by the Legislature for undergraduates in Massachusetts enrolled in an approved public or independent college, university, school of nursing or other approved institution.
funding.eligibility: U.S. citizen, permanent legal resident or eligible non-citizen who has lived in Massachusetts at least one year with intent to remain. Full-time enrollment (12 or more credits) in a certificate, associate's or bachelor's program; no prior bachelor's degree; demonstrated financial need; satisfactory academic progress; not in default on student loans (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA, or the Massachusetts Application for State Financial Aid (MASFA) if ineligible for the FAFSA.

funding.name: MassEducate (Free Community College)
funding.provides: Community college tuition and fees are free for students through MassReconnect (ages 25 and older) and MassEducate.
funding.eligibility: Must complete the FAFSA or MASFA, not have a bachelor's degree or equivalent, meet satisfactory academic progress, and meet residency and citizenship requirements. A student who already holds an associate degree may use MassEducate for one additional associate degree (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA, or the MASFA if ineligible for the FAFSA (per page).

funding.name: In-Demand Scholarship
funding.provides: Scholarships for residents pursuing programs of study that meet Massachusetts workforce needs. Created in the FY2024 budget. Recipients are expected to remain in the Commonwealth to pursue their careers.
funding.eligibility: Admitted undergraduate or graduate student who meets citizenship and residency requirements, completes the FAFSA or MASFA each year, and is pursuing a program designated by the state labor market reports (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA, or the MASFA if ineligible (per page).
